0022600093.text: Both the Sacramento Kings and LA Clippers open their 2026-27 seasons in this game, with the Kings on the road. Sacramento will be without Dylan Cardwell (calf strain) and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee), and Malik Monk is day-to-day with ankle soreness and a game-time decision. The Clippers will be missing Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery), Max Strus (foot) and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery), and ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Kings a 35% chance to win.
